ja240:1.1: All people were harassed by Piṅgala,
ja240:1.2: Now, because he is dead, they feel (delight),
ja240:1.3: What was the one with tawny eyes to you?
ja240:1.4: Why are you crying, watchman of the door?
ja240:2.1: The one with tawny eyes wasn’t dear to me,
ja240:2.2: (But) his coming back I (truly) do fear,
ja240:2.3: Going from here should he harass Death’s King,
ja240:2.4: Being harassed he may sent him back here.
ja240:3.1: He’s burned by thousands of cartloads,
ja240:3.2: cooled by hundreds of water pots,
ja240:3.3: The earth has been dug up,
ja240:3.4: please do not fear, he is not coming back!
